adjudication.depicted_input: BioMedGPT-10B multimodal alignment panel showing molecule and protein inputs passed through modality encoders, projected into the BioMedGPT-LM feature space, and inserted at the model interface as the route-specific multimodal input mechanism.
adjudication.rationale: The current crop is defensible for the molecule and protein fine-tuning routes. It visibly shows the route-specific source objects and immediate input interface: molecule/protein inputs, their encoders, and the aligned features entering the language-model core with the Mol/Prot instruction-question interface. Under the atlas rules, the exact variant name need not appear when the paper uses a shared architecture figure for the same input mechanism, and training/fine-tuning routes are valid scope. The rejection relies on an overly strict exact-box-name requirement that the rules explicitly do not impose. This crop does not clearly support the biomedical QA text-only fine-tuning route, so only the two multimodal routes are supported.
